title.en: Nuh (AS): The Ship and the Flood

status: draft: to be checked by a scholar before public release

say.en: One prophet called his people for nearly a thousand years. Only a few believed. Then came the water.
say.hi: Ek paighambar ne apni qaum ko lagbhag hazaar saal tak bulaya. Bas thode se log imaan laaye. Phir paani aaya.

say.en: Allah sent Nuh to his people: Warn your people, before a painful punishment comes to them.
say.hi: Allah ne Nuh ko unki qaum ki taraf bheja: apni qaum ko daraao, isse pehle ke un par dardnaak azaab aa jaaye.

say.en: He stayed among them a thousand years minus fifty. Calling them to worship Allah alone.
say.hi: Woh unke beech hazaar saal mein pachaas kam rahe. Unhein sirf ek Allah ki ibadat ki taraf bulate rahe.

say.en: Every time he invited them so that Allah would forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their clothes, and grew more arrogant.
say.hi: Jab bhi unhone bulaya taake Allah unhein maaf kar de, unhone kaanon mein ungliyan daal leen, kapde odh liye, aur aur bhi ghamand karne lage.

say.en: He told them: Ask your Lord for forgiveness, He is ever forgiving. He will send rain upon you, and give you wealth and children, gardens and rivers.
say.hi: Unhone kaha: apne Rabb se maafi maango, woh bahut maaf karne wala hai. Woh tum par baarish bhejega, aur tumhein maal aur aulad, baagh aur nehrein dega.

say.en: They called him a madman and drove him away. So he called upon his Lord: I am overpowered, so help.
say.hi: Unhone unhein deewana kaha aur jhidak diya. To unhone apne Rabb ko pukaara: main haar gaya hoon, ab Tu madad kar.

say.en: Allah told him that no more of his people would believe. Build the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration.
say.hi: Allah ne unhein bata diya ke ab unki qaum mein se aur koi imaan nahi laayega. Kashti banao, hamari nigraani aur hamari wahi ke mutabiq.

say.en: So Nuh built the ship Allah had commanded. And whenever the chiefs of his people passed by, they mocked him. He said: If you mock us, we will mock you just as you mock.
say.hi: To Nuh ne woh kashti banayi jiska Allah ne hukm diya tha. Aur jab bhi unki qaum ke sardar guzarte, unka mazaaq udaate. Unhone kaha: agar tum hum par hanste ho, to hum bhi tum par waise hi hansenge.

say.en: Then Allah opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain, and made the earth burst with springs. And the waters met for a matter already decreed.
say.hi: Phir Allah ne mooslaadhaar baarish se aasman ke darwaze khol diye, aur zameen se chashme phoot pade. Aur dono paani ek tay shuda kaam ke liye mil gaye.

heading.en: IN THE NAME OF ALLAH | *IT SAILS*
heading.hi: ALLAH KE NAAM SE | *YEH CHALTI HAI*

say.en: He said: Board it. In the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.
say.hi: Unhone kaha: is mein sawar ho jao. Allah ke naam se hai iska chalna aur iska thehrna. Beshak mera Rabb bahut maaf karne wala, reham karne wala hai.

say.en: It sailed through waves like mountains. Nuh called to his son: Come aboard with us. He said: I will go up a mountain. Nuh said: Today there is no protector from Allah's decree, except for whom He has mercy. And the waves came between them.
say.hi: Kashti pahaadon jaisi lehron mein chali. Nuh ne apne bete ko pukaara: hamare saath sawar ho jaa. Woh bola: main kisi pahaad par chadh jaaunga. Nuh ne kaha: aaj Allah ke faisle se koi bachane wala nahi, siwaye uske jis par woh reham kare. Aur lehrein dono ke beech aa gayin.

say.en: Then it was said: O earth, swallow your water. O sky, hold back. The water went down, the matter was done, and the ship came to rest on Al-Judi.
say.hi: Phir kaha gaya: aye zameen, apna paani nigal le. Aye aasman, tham ja. Paani utar gaya, faisla ho gaya, aur kashti Judi par jaa thehri.

say.en: It was said: O Nuh, go down in peace from Us, with blessings upon you and upon the nations from those with you.
say.hi: Kaha gaya: aye Nuh, hamari taraf se salamati ke saath utro, tum par aur tumhare saathiyon ki naslon par barkatein hain.

say.en: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: on the Day of Resurrection, Nuh will be asked: Did you convey the message? He will say yes. His people will say: No warner came to us. Nuh will name his witnesses: Muhammad and his followers. And you will bear witness.
say.hi: Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya: qayamat ke din Nuh se poocha jaayega: kya tumne paigham pahuncha diya? Woh kahenge haan. Unki qaum kahegi: hamare paas koi daraane wala nahi aaya. Nuh apne gawah batayenge: Muhammad aur unki ummat. Aur tum gawahi doge.

say.en: Allah left the ship as a sign. So is there anyone who will remember? When no one seems to listen, keep calling, with patience, like Nuh did.
say.hi: Allah ne is kashti ko ek nishani bana kar chhoda. To hai koi jo naseehat le? Jab koi sunta na lage, to sabr ke saath bulate raho, jaise Nuh bulate rahe.

heading.en: SEND THIS TO SOMEONE | *WHO FEELS UNHEARD*
heading.hi: YEH USAY BHEJEIN | *JISKI KOI NAHI SUNTA*

say.en: Send this to someone who has been calling for a long time, and feels no one is listening.
say.hi: Yeh video usay bhejein, jo der se pukaar raha hai aur lagta hai koi nahi sun raha.
